This policy applies to all Brightwater Analytics employees from 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2025.

Every full-time employee receives 18 days of annual leave per calendar year. Unused annual leave may be carried forward into the next year with no upper limit.

p05.text:
# Travel and Expenses Policy

This policy applies to all business travel from 1 January 2026.

## Limits

The daily meal limit is 60 US dollars when travelling within the country and 90 US dollars when travelling abroad.
The hotel limit is 180 US dollars per night.

## Approval

Any trip longer than 5 days needs approval from the employee's director in addition to their direct manager.

## Claims

Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the end of the trip. Claims submitted later are paid only with approval from the Chief Financial Officer.

# Project Beacon

Project Beacon builds the demand forecasting service sold to customers as the Forecast Pro product.

## Ownership

Project Beacon is owned by the Applied Machine Learning team. Kenji Watanabe is the project sponsor and Sofia Haddad is the technical lead.

## Budget and schedule

The approved budget for Project Beacon is 260,000 US dollars. The first release is planned for November 2026.

## Dependencies

Project Beacon cannot launch until Project Atlas is complete, because the forecasting models train on the new columnar warehouse.

Model accuracy on small retailers

# Project Atlas

Project Atlas is the migration of Brightwater's customer reporting warehouse to a new columnar store.

## Ownership

Project Atlas is owned by the Data Platform team. Aisha Bello is the project sponsor and Lucas Moreau is the technical lead.

## Budget and schedule

The approved budget for Project Atlas is 420,000 US dollars. The migration started in February 2026 and is due to finish in September 2026.

## Dependencies

Project Atlas depends on the IT Operations team provisioning the new storage cluster.
